title: Power scale: how strong things get
text: Damage grows with you. Your Existence Points (EP) multiply your spell and skill damage: x1 at 1,000 EP, x3.5 at 10,000, x6 at 100,000, x8.5 at 1 million, up to x12. A second boost, late-game scaling, starts above 10,000 max magicules: x2.25 at 100,000, x3.5 at 1 million, x6 at 100 million. Skill mastery adds x0.85 to x1.15. Hard ceilings keep it fair (server file nusmp-damage-server.toml): no hit from this mod does more than 10,000; one apex weapon, Elsdocia, may reach 15,000; the 36 Djinn weapons sit between 4,000 (weakest) and 8,000 (strongest). A player never loses more than 40% of their maximum health to one hit (pvpHitCapPercent), and a boss never loses more than 6% of its health per second. Power raises: while your Djinn is out, a Beast Will is held, or a Seven Star or Vassal weapon is in hand, you hit x25 (nusmp-power-server.toml); the four Legendary Weapons x37.5. The largest applies, never the product. See Rarity and grades for the item ladder.
